name: CymtX Player
author: Tiedeyez
description: CymtX (called Halo until 1.1.0) in your bar: the song playing in CymtX, the native music player that turns every song into a mandala of pixel sand, with a small player behind it: cover, seek, play/pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, Blend, Drift, sleep timer, moments, volume and the line being sung. It only runs /usr/bin/cymtx with a fixed list of commands; it writes no files, edits no configuration and opens no network connection. Needs the CymtX app, installed from this repository.

barWidget.description: Now playing in CymtX, with a player: cover, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, Blend, Drift, sleep timer and lyrics
